11 years ago I went with my wife to Jamaica. It was our honey moon. At our resort they made a drink they sold under the name "howard." I have the ingredients but I don't have the recipe. What I am hoping is that it is close enough to other drinks that yall can help me figure out how to mix it.

It contains Dark Rum, Peach Schnapps, Orange Juice, Pineapple Juice, Grenadine and Strawberry Puree. Clearly this is a fruity beach drink served in a pint glass. We have been playing with the amounts. Any help would be appreciated. Thaks.

Most cocktails follow a similar structure, with some variation on measurements. However, you can generally expect that the primary alcohol, in this case the Dark Rum, will be anywhere from a 1 oz. measurement, to 2 oz. Balance would suggest about a 1 ½ oz. shot, depending on both strength and flavor. The secondary alcohol, or liqueur, in this case the Peach Schnapps, would probably be a portion anywhere between ½ oz. measurement, to 1 oz. I'd settle for somewhere in the middle, about ¾ shot. Juice's and flavorings, even if there are multiple - often make up about 60-70% of the Cocktail. In this case, I'd shoot for about 2 oz. each of the Pineapple Juice, and the Orange Juice. Grenadine is usually a minimal ingredient; less is more. Aim for about a ½ oz. Flavorings like the Strawberry Puree are deceptively strong, and often overly sweet, and should be kept minimal as well. ½ oz. to 1 oz measurement.

Personally, I would set aside a Pint Glass, filled with ice. Add all ingredients, with the exception of the grenadine, to a mixing tin filled partially with ice. Shake 5-6 Times, and strain over the fresh ice. Add the Grenadine last, as if the colors come out right, it should add a layer of extra color to the drink, for style points. Garnish with an Orange Wheel, A Cube of Pineapple, and a Cherry.

This drink has a lot of similarities to a Bahama Mama. Primarily in the use of Rum (though the Bahama Mama uses light Rum,) the Juice ingredients, and the Grenadine. I followed a similar pattern to how I would build a Bahama Mama in creating this interpretation of your recipe.
Ha, I just read through your reply and it uses the exact same logic I used to get to my conclusion, just explained better.

40ml dark Meyers Planters Rum, 20ml Peach schnapps, 10ml Grenadine. 20ml strawberry puree (assuming its natural and not too sweet)

pour over ice, big ice cubes not the small pieces of shit you will find at a chain restaurant.

top with juice 50-50 over the ice.

Shake and pour over ice again to your pint glass. If you haven't filled up the glass, top with more juice.

Make sure the rum is dark Jamaican, not Bacardi 8 or some shit, it is distilled differently.

Trust me, I worked cruise ships and hotels in my young days. This is the recipe.
